summary: Shared exception types: TransactionError with subclasses TransactionUnsupportedError, TransactionPoisonedError and TransactionIntegrityError, plus BackendConnectionError for connection failures whose message has been stripped of credentials.
extension_points: Alternative Backend implementations should raise these types so callers can handle transaction failures uniformly.
lifecycle_notes: TransactionPoisonedError: a caught nested failure aborted the unit; it is rolled back, never committed.
TransactionIntegrityError: native state was unknown on entry or not committable at exit; nothing is committed.
documentation_hooks: Error-handling reference for transaction() and connect().
risks: Not re-exported from the package root, so users must import them from mountainash_data.core.errors.
open_questions: Should the transaction exceptions be exported from mountainash_data alongside Backend?

evidence.detail: Shared transaction cases import the error types
